name: vibe-kanban-cloud
description: Deploy Vibe Kanban Cloud on Unraid. This is a true Docker-in-Docker wrapper that runs the entire Cloud stack (remote-server, Postgres, ElectricSQL, Caddy). Important: You MUST use Privileged mode. For Local setups without domain, enter your local IP in DOMAIN and it will auto-generate an SSL cert you can find in your appdata. For External proxies (Nginx/Traefik), set USE_EXTERNAL_PROXY to true and map the External App Port.

paths.name: Path: Appdata Directory
paths.description: Persistent storage for all data (database, electric, SSL certs, generated secrets in .env).

ports.name: Port: HTTP (Internal Proxy)
ports.description: Internal Caddy HTTP Port (used if USE_EXTERNAL_PROXY=false).

ports.name: Port: HTTPS (Internal Proxy)
ports.description: Internal Caddy HTTPS Port (used if USE_EXTERNAL_PROXY=false).

ports.name: Port: External App (Direct)
ports.description: Direct access to Vibe Kanban App (used if USE_EXTERNAL_PROXY=true). Point your external reverse proxy to this port.

variables.name: Variable: Domain (IP or FQDN)
variables.description: Your domain. If you enter a local IP/hostname (e.g. 192.168.x.x), Caddy uses internal SSL. If public FQDN, Caddy uses Let's Encrypt.

variables.name: Variable: External Proxy Mode
variables.description: Set to 'true' if you use Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik, or an external Caddy. This disables the internal Caddy.

variables.name: Variable: TLS Email
variables.description: (Optional) Email address for Let's Encrypt ACME registration if you use a public domain and internal Caddy.

variables.name: --- Local Authentication ---
variables.description: Bootstrap credentials for initial setup without OAuth.

variables.name: Variable: Local Admin Email
variables.description: The email address to use for the bootstrap admin.

variables.name: Variable: Local Admin Password
variables.description: Secure password for the bootstrap admin.

variables.name: Variable: PUID
variables.description: Container User ID for file ownership in /data (default: 99).

variables.name: Variable: PGID
variables.description: Container Group ID for file ownership in /data (default: 100).
